pd_new_teacher_mentoring_001.evidence: A unit member who is assigned by the Board to serve as a mentor for a new teacher shall receive an annual stipend of $600 for each new teacher mentored. A unit member who has completed MCPS mentor training shall receive $700 per year, and $800 per year effective July 1, 2009.

pd_teacher_leadership_002.evidence: Lead Teachers—Effective July 1, 2009, lead leachers who serve in teacher leadership positions identified as part of the Career Lattice program will receive a supplement of $2,000... Middle School Team Leaders—Will have their regular scheduled salary in Grades A-D increased $1,500... Elected Faculty Representatives to School Leadership Team... will have their regular scheduled salary increased $1,500.

pd_career_ladder_003.evidence: Lead Teachers—Effective July 1, 2009, lead leachers who serve in teacher leadership positions identified as part of the Career Lattice program will receive a supplement of $2,000, in addition to any supplement provided for the specific position.
